args.text: Can you pull together every site on Marrow Agrisupply you can find across #central-team? List each with where it comes from. Need it before the customer call.

Here's every Marrow Agrisupply site I could find in #central-team. The channel only names two of them for sure, plus one that might be theirs:

1. Eastbank: Hollis, Jun 9 2026 (10:46 AM). Ticket PD-4821 has the Eastbank receiving-door import attached. The file labels the doors E1/E2, but their booking sheet uses 01/02, so that has to be sorted out before anyone reimports.

2. Pine Crossing: you, Jun 9 2026 (10:48 AM). The morning receiver only sees the afternoon shift on the appointment screen. A 7:10 driver got logged on a sticky note. Hollis said he'd check the shift template and have support reproduce it with the store login (10:50 AM).

3. Wichita (not confirmed as Marrow): you, Jul 2 2025 (9:21 AM). You mentioned an 8am check-in with "the Wichita store dispatcher," right after Tobias said your Zoom was hosting the Marrow Agrisupply office hours link. The channel never actually ties Wichita to Marrow, so please double-check before you use it.

I left out the Tulsa hub (that's Tansley Parcel) and Door 6 / ticket #88412 (that's Tansleigh Packaging).

Also, Hollis's Jun 9 post says the rollout tracker covers more new stores, and three rows just say "waiting." None of those stores are named in the channel, so the full list is probably in the tracker or in your notes from the store ops calls.
